note: Read from JLCPCB's published rigid PCB capabilities page on the date above (1 oz copper unless stated). JLC changes these; check the page before relying on a limit. Values in mm.

min_trace_width.text: Min. track width and spacing (1 oz): 0.10/0.10 mm (2-layer), 0.09/0.09 mm (multilayer); 3 mil is acceptable in BGA fan-outs

trace_coil_spacing.text: Trace coils: 0.15/0.15mm (covered by solder mask); 0.25/0.25 mm uncovered, ENIG only

min_via_drill.text: Min. via hole 0.15 mm; 0.1 mm only for boards up to 1 mm thick with ENIG/OSP

min_via_diameter.text: Via diameter should be 0.1mm (0.15mm preferred) larger than the via hole

pth_to_track.text: PTH to track: 0.35mm is recommended, minimum 0.28mm

pad_to_track.text: Pad to track clearance (1 oz): 0.1 mm; 0.09 mm locally for BGA pads

smd_pad_to_pad.text: SMD pad to pad clearance (different nets): 0.15mm

pth_annular_ring.text: PTH annular ring: 2-layer recommended 0.25 mm, absolute minimum 0.18 mm; multilayer recommended 0.20 mm, absolute minimum 0.15 mm

min_pth_drill.text: PTH hole 0.15 mm (0.1 mm for boards up to 1 mm, costlier); 0.5 mm or more recommended

copper_to_routed_edge.text: Copper clearance from routed board edges: >= 0.2 mm

copper_to_vcut_edge.text: Copper clearance from V-cut board edges: >= 0.4 mm

silkscreen_min_line.text: Characters width less than 0.15mm will be unidentifiable

silkscreen_min_text_height.text: Minimum text height: 40 mil (1.0mm), width to height 1:6

soldermask_bridge.text: Min. pad spacing for a mask dam: 0.10 mm (green, red, yellow, blue, purple), 0.13 mm (black, white); 2 oz 0.20 mm
